DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement in the brainstem and cerebellum, combined with your history of gait and limb ataxia, are diagnostic for PML, likely secondary to an underlying immunocompromised state or specific medication use.
